name: Tevogen Bio Holdings Inc.
summary: Tevogen Inc., a clinical-stage specialty immunotherapy company, develops off-the-shelf, precision T cell therapies for the treatment of infectious diseases, cancers, and other disorders. The company develops TVGN 489, which has completed Phase 1 clinical trial for the treatment of ambulatory high-risk adult COVID-19 patients; and in Phase 1 clinical trial to treat acute SARS-CoV-2 patients with B-cell cancer immune suppression, and other B cell immune suppressed acute SARS-CoV-2 patients with a B cell cancer indication, as well as Long COVID prevention and treatment.
